typography.usage: Use title font for headlines and CTA labels; use body font for body copy and long text.

palette.background_rule: Derive background by boosting primary saturation by ~+30% and value to ≥90% (poster tone).
palette.text_rule: Derive text by desaturating primary to ≤15% saturation and reducing value to ≈20–30% (near black).
palette.accent_rule: Accent can be primary with +0.04 hue shift and +10–20% saturation for chips/badges.

button.instruction: Use a solid rectangular CTA with crisp edges and strong black outline. Keep motion minimal.

badge.instruction: Render a status tag that reads as trustworthy. Prefer a checkmark prefix.

section.instruction: Use a clean section with a thin line header. Prioritize grids and whitespace.
section.layout: stacked: header bar then content block
